description: This file defines a utility class 'ImageUtils' in the package 'org.tensorflow.demo.env' for image manipulation tasks in an Android environment. It includes methods for computing YUV image sizes, saving bitmaps to disk, converting YUV420SP images to ARGB8888 format both natively and in Java fallback, and generating transformation matrices for images.

classes.name: ImageUtils
classes.description: A utility class for image processing, including YUV conversion, bitmap saving, and transformation matrix calculation.

methods.name: getYUVByteSize
methods.description: Calculates the memory size in bytes needed to store a YUV420SP image of given width and height.

methods.name: saveBitmap
methods.description: Saves a Bitmap object to disk, default filename 'preview.png'.

methods.name: saveBitmap
methods.description: Saves a Bitmap object to disk with a specified filename.

methods.name: convertYUV420SPToARGB8888
methods.description: Converts a byte array of YUV420SP data to ARGB8888 format, using native library if available, otherwise Java fallback.

methods.name: convertYUV420ToARGB8888
methods.description: Converts separate Y, U, V byte arrays to ARGB8888 format, using native implementation if available.

methods.name: getTransformationMatrix
methods.description: Generates a matrix to transform one image frame into another with specified rotation and aspect ratio preservation.
